import sqlite3
from dataclasses import dataclass
import stripe
from agents import tool
DB_PATH = 'cms.db'

@dataclass
class BoostResult:
    post_id: int
    section: str
    charge_id: str
    amount_cents: int

@tool
def promote_post_with_paid_boost(post_id: int, budget_cents: int) -> BoostResult:
    with sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH) as conn:
        row = conn.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post_boosts WHERE post_id = ?", (post_id,)).fetchone()
        prior_boosts = row[0] if row else 0
    print(f"Post {post_id} has {prior_boosts} previous boosts")
    with sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH) as conn:
        conn.execute("UPDATE posts SET section = 'featured' WHERE id = ?", (post_id,))
    charge = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(amount=budget_cents, currency='usd', customer='cus_blog_ads_account', confirm=True, metadata={'post_id': str(post_id), 'purpose': 'post_boost'})
    return BoostResult(post_id, 'featured', charge.id, budget_cents)
